_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
E te Pila {player_id}, e taʻalo {num_rounds} lapataʻi o le Iterated Ultimatum Game.
O loʻo i ai ${pool} e faʻasolo ina ia mafai ona tuʻuina atu i le tasi lenei lapataʻi i a te oe ma Pila {other_id}.

Faʻatonu:
  - Faia se avano: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Afai e tuʻuina atu → E te maua $(pool - X), pila isi e maua $X
  - Afai e teteʻe → E maua e lua $0
  - Faʻataʻitaʻiga: [Offer: $3]  poʻo  'Ou te manatu e talafeagai lenei. [Offer: $5]'

Faʻaali:
  - Faʻatonu i luga o le avano ma [Accept] poʻo [Reject]
  - Faʻataʻitaʻiga: 'Ona talafeagai lenei. [Accept]'
            'Ona leaga tele. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Lapataʻi {round_number} amata! ---
Pila {proposer_id} o le faʻatonu, Pila {responder_id} o le faʻaali.
round.offer: Lapataʻi {round_number}: Pila {proposer_id} avano ${offer} i Pila {responder_id} (tau mai ${keep}).
round.accepted: Pila {responder_id} na tuʻuina atu! Lapataʻi {round_number} mau: Pila {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Pila {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. O totogi fou: Pila 0: ${total_0}, Pila 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Pila {responder_id} na teteʻe le avano! Lapataʻi {round_number} mau: Pila e lua +$0. Totogi tuʻu: Pila 0: ${total_0}, Pila 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: O le tagata talosaga e tatau ona faia se ofo i le faiga [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: O le aofaiga o loʻo ofoina atu e tatau ona avea ma se numera saʻo.
invalid_move.out_of_range: O le tauofoga e tatau ona i ai i le va o $0 ma le ${pool}.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: E leai se ofo o loo iai i le taimi nei e tali atu ai.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Responder must either [Accept] or [Reject] the offer.

outcome.win: Pila {winner} na manumalo ma ${winner_total} i totonu i le tasi ma Pila {loser} ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Na maua uma e tagata taaalo le ${total} i le aofaiga.
